findings.title: Unresolved design items cannot resume once their design exists
findings.description: `slices-plan` selects only undesigned slices. After design creation succeeds but its review remains unresolved, reevaluating that source excludes the flagged item. Both retry and accept therefore return REJECTED instead of resolving it. The planning-batch test masks this by continuing to report the slice as undesigned. Support resuming an existing, unresolved design and test that actual lifecycle.

findings.title: Item resume mutates unregistered worktrees before checking registration
findings.description: Unlike `enter_slice_branch`, this precondition never calls the worktree-registration guard. In an unregistered linked worktree, it can use the primary checkout’s integration target, commit leftovers, and switch branches before any later guard rejects execution. Validate registration before reading or acting on that target.

findings.title: Synchronous subprocesses block the item-resume event loop
findings.description: The async resume path directly performs synchronous state reads, git operations, cf subprocess calls, and report writes. Git commands alone permit 30-second timeouts, violating the required sub-millisecond synchronous-work bound. Move blocking operations off-loop and add a responsiveness/load test.

findings.title: Report loading does not validate item shapes
findings.description:
`cast` does not validate parsed JSON. For example, `"items": [null]` reaches `BatchItemRecord.from_json(None)` and raises `AttributeError`, escaping the documented `BatchReportLoadError` contract and item-resume rejection handler. Validate the external report with Pydantic and test malformed item types.

Full tests could not run: the available Python environment lacks installed `squadron-ai` package metadata.
